faces.name: Norn's Annex

effect.reason: The attack tax scales in a coloured symbol, and no Cost can say it. CantAttack's unlessPays takes a Cost, and the only Cost that scales is PayManaCost, whose generic is an Amount but whose colored part is a fixed printed string: one {W/P} per attacking creature is neither generic mana nor a printed constant. ManaCost is a fixed string too. Writing Times(AttackersAgainst(You), 2) as generic would charge {2} per creature, which is Ghostly Prison and a different card, and dropping the rider would make the prohibition absolute.
effect.text: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {W/P} for each of those creatures.

abilities.text: Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {W/P} for each of those creatures.

effect.reason: CantAttack's 'player' field protects only a single player from attacks; it has no field extending that protection to 'planeswalkers you control' the way AttackersAgainst's includingPermanentsTheyControl flag extends a count, so the restriction's scope cannot be written without silently narrowing it to attacks on you alone
